title: Disabling microphone through Audio Volume popup does not allow you to enable it with a keyboard mic mute shortcut
line: The microphone mute key now unmutes a microphone that was muted from the Audio Volume popup.
explanation: Since Plasma 6.5 the microphone mute shortcut only toggles a global mute layered on top of each device's own mute. If the default microphone was already muted from the applet, the first press turned the global mute on (the mic stayed muted) and the next press lifted only the global mute, which never touches devices it did not mute itself, so the microphone could not be unmuted from the keyboard. The shortcut now checks the preferred microphone: if it is muted (or the global mute is on), it lifts the global mute and unmutes that microphone; otherwise it applies the global mute as before. Other microphones the user muted explicitly stay muted.

commits.message:
kded: Unmute the default microphone with the mute shortcut when muted

When the microphone had been muted in the applet, the mute shortcut only
toggled the global mute on top of it, so the microphone stayed muted no
matter how often it was pressed. Now the shortcut unmutes it instead.

BUG: 511276

media.caption: Before: pressing the microphone mute key shows "Microphone Muted" and the microphone stays muted
After: pressing the microphone mute key unmutes it (OSD at 100%, popup button shows unmuted)

review.text: Clean, minimal fix in plasma-pa's AudioShortcutsService that resolves the Plasma 6.5 regression where a microphone muted in the Audio Volume popup could not be unmuted via the keyboard mic-mute shortcut. Checking the preferred source's mute state alongside globalMuteSources unmutes the default microphone in a single keypress without unmuting other explicitly muted sources, addressing the objections to the stalled RFC MR. Null checks are safe, there is no double-OSD race with handleSourceDataChanged, and screenshots and multi-mic regression tests verify the behavior.

reviews.text: Clean, minimal fix in plasma-pa's AudioShortcutsService that resolves the Plasma 6.5 regression where a microphone muted in the Audio Volume popup could not be unmuted via the keyboard mic-mute shortcut. Checking the preferred source's mute state alongside globalMuteSources unmutes the default microphone in a single keypress without unmuting other explicitly muted sources, addressing the objections to the stalled RFC MR. Null checks are safe, there is no double-OSD race with handleSourceDataChanged, and screenshots and multi-mic regression tests verify the behavior.

The diagnosis is right (the 6.5 global-mute layer never lifts a device mute it did not set, so a mic muted in the applet can't be unmuted by the key), and unmuting only the preferred mic is a sensible answer to pallaswept's objection; the after shot shows the key unmuting it. But the applet's 'Force mute all input devices' checkbox (applet/main.qml -> GlobalService::globalMuteSources()) invokes this same mic_mute action, so with the patch, checking that box while the default mic is muted in the applet unmutes the default mic and leaves global mute off: the item labelled 'Force mute all' turns a microphone on, a privacy regression the verify notes don't cover. The same applies if the default mic is muted but another, non-default mic is live: pressing the mute key unmutes the default instead of muting anything.
changes: Keep the 'Force mute all input devices' menu item a pure global-mute toggle: e.g. give the applet its own kded entry point (or a separate hidden action) that calls enableGlobalSourceMute()/disableGlobalSourceMute() based on the checkbox state, and apply the 'unmute the preferred mic' logic only to the keyboard shortcut.

Only unmute the preferred mic when no other source is currently unmuted (or otherwise make sure a press never leaves an unmuted mic live while unmuting another), or justify the current behaviour in the commit message.
Add the context-menu checkbox and the 'other mic unmuted' cases to the verify/regression notes.
